articles.title: Minsk-Karachi railway shows Eurasia’s quiet geopolitical rewiring
articles.summary: The news that Pakistan, Russia, and Belarus are working on a test freight railway connecting Minsk, Moscow, and Karachi may seem like just another infrastructure project needing funding and construction. However, the real importance of this initiative lies in what it shows about the rapid shift in Eurasia’s economic geography.

articles.title: Olivia Rodrigo's festival is uniting women and girls behind nonprofits promoting their well-being
articles.summary: Daisy Chain Fields on Saturday (Aug 29) united a women-led lineup boasting queer pop star Chappell Roan, breakout rapper Doechii and riot grrrl pioneers Bikini Kill behind issues of women's health, workplace protections and legal rights. Olivia Rodrigo's festival is uniting women and girls behind nonprofits promoting their well-being.

articles.title: US Conducts Fresh Strikes On Iranian Launchers, Seen As "Signal' To Tehran On Hormuz
articles.summary: US forces struck two Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz after the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) was observed preparing to launch rockets carrying sea mines into the vital waterway, a US official confirmed to RFE/RL. US Strike On Iranian Launchers Signals Resolve To Keep Hormuz Open, Experts Say. US Conducts Fresh Strikes On Iranian Launchers, Seen As "Signal' To Tehran On Hormuz.

articles.title: What a cancer survivor’s wrongful dismissal case tells us about the employer-employee relationship
articles.summary: When illness strikes or life gets in the way, employees will become temporarily less available to their employers. This is normal and should not be an exception to be managed away, say SUSS professor Victor Seah and Singapore Cancer Society’s Tan Kwang Cheak. What a cancer survivor’s wrongful dismissal case tells us about the employer-employee relationship.

articles.title: Ukrainian Officials Blamed For 'Negligence' After Deadly Strikes

articles.title: ‘The lake is our life’: Protecting a shared lifeline in Uganda

articles.summary: An "all-Russian" MC-21 passenger jet made its first test flight in early August, marking a step closer to full production, due to begin in 2027. But years of geopolitical turbulence have pushed the project far off-course, aviation insiders say. Russia's 'Make Or Break' Airliner Approaches Production Amid Sanctions And Shortages.

articles.title: Civilian risks grow as military activity continues, UN says

UN warns of growing civilian risks as military activity continues. Civilian risks grow as military activity continues, UN says.

articles.title: Security Council LIVE: Tracking Syria’s transition
articles.summary: As Damascus continues to rebuild after more than a decade of war – from the recent dissolution of the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces to the United States’ removal of Syria from its sponsors of terrorism list – a top UN official warned the Security Council on Thursday that international support can help tackle outstanding challenges. articles.title: Shock and devastation remain, a day after Himalayan flood disaster
articles.summary: Amid reports that hundreds of people are still missing in Nepal and China after a floodwater surge slammed into towns and villages on Wednesday, aid teams have been working to reach communities cut off by the disaster. Shock and devastation remain, a day after Himalayan flood disaster.

articles.title: Hollow Promises: Resetting Gaza’s Ceasefire
articles.summary: A July roadmap sponsored by the Board of Peace has failed to overcome obstacles that have mired Gaza’s ceasefire deal ten months on. A mix of sustained pressure and diplomatic guarantees is needed to break the logjam and centre Palestinian agency in the strip's recovery. Hollow Promises: Resetting Gaza’s Ceasefire.

articles.title: Curbing Reprisals in Syria
articles.summary: Fuelled by wartime grievances, mob attacks and other forms of retribution threaten Syria’s transition. Damascus has done too little to deter such acts. It should ensure visible legal consequences for violence and broaden locally rooted policing to rebuild trust among vulnerable communities. Curbing Reprisals in Syria.
